note: Single source of truth for SQC screens. User-facing navigation is organized under four gateways: the complete accounting program, financial statements & reporting assistant, intelligent multi-round audit system, and independent helper tools. The legacy eight groups remain as internal studios/subgroups for compatibility, company scoping and deep links. Command palette, permissions and rebuild docs are generated from this registry.
